# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: Touch_Multi's wait arm.
# map mp_carentan with its entity lump patched (same length, every offset
# kept): bombzone_A "wait" "5", bombzone_B "wait" "0", auto1 (*7) "wait" "-1",
# auto2 (*10) turned into a trigger_once. The patched bsp went into a
# zzz_trigwait.pk3 in the server's homepath; linkto_ab.rs's `trigwait_bsp`
# applies the same four replacements. Gametype dm, served as probe_trigwait,
# one client joined allies. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client
# about 10 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29671 PROBE_SECS=55 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_trigwait mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29671 --probe-team allies --probe-secs 40
# probe_trigwait.gsc moves one trigger at a time onto the parked player by an
# origin write for 20 frames: w5 (bombzone_A), w0 (bombzone_B), wlink (auto1
# after enableLinkTo, no parent), once (auto2). It ends on enableLinkTo on a
# script_origin, whose fatal is the last measurement.
# docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 17, is what it measured.
#   PROBE f <targetname> <num> <classname>
#   PROBE d <phase> <time> <isdefined> <trigger_multiple + trigger_once count>
#   PROBE n <phase> <time> <toucher>                  every "trigger" notify
# The client sent about three cmds a server frame, so a frame the player
# touched a trigger on carries up to three n lines.
PROBE f bombzone_A 176 trigger_multiple
PROBE f bombzone_B 171 trigger_multiple
PROBE f auto1 179 trigger_multiple
PROBE f auto2 246 trigger_once
